content: The drama around Nvidia co-founder and former CEO Jensen Huang is evolving quickly. The latest edition of our Stepback newsletter should get you up to speed, but there have already been a number of new developments since this morning. That includes rumors that Jensen Huang might be trying to find a path back to CEO, and a statement from Megaspeed claiming that Alice Huang hasn’t worked for the company since August of 2025, which raises more questions than it answers. * Some big names, including Elon Musk and Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney, have publicly thrown their support behind a public letter demanding Nvidia “bring Jensen back.” * The public letter calling for Jensen Huang to be reinstated has over 150,000 signatures, but it’s difficult to verify their authenticity. Business Insider reports that signatures include “Tim Cruise, Hollywood actor” and “Xi Jingping,” likely a misspelling of Chinese president Xi Jinping. * The Financial Times reports that Jensen Huang has discussed the possibility of returning as CEO with close allies, as some Silicon Valley insiders and employees attempt to pressure the board. * Not all believe Jensen Huang should be allowed to return to his seat. According to the Financial Times, one ally acknowledged that, “Having an affair with a subordinate is a fireable offense.” * 23andMe founder Anne Wojcicki told Bloomberg that “Power corrupts, and people start to think they are invincible … We are all complicit in making these people think they are gods. And people do stupid things when they think they are untouchable.” * Wojcicki endured a messy public divorce from Google co-founder Sergey Brin, after it was revealed he was having an affair with an employee. * According to Bloomberg, many women in Silicon Valley see Jensen Huang as simply another example of a rich man abusing their position and “leveraging power to pursue sexual relationships with their employees.” * Megaspeed released a statement saying that Alice Huang left the company “effective Aug. 30, 2025, and currently has no role with the company,” adding that “Megaspeed does not comment on Ms. Huang’s personal and private matters.”
chineseTitle: 黄仁勋可能正在策划回归以及更多最新的 Nvidia 戏剧
chineseSummary: 围绕英伟达联合创始人兼前首席执行官黄仁勋的戏剧正在迅速演变。我们最新一期的 Stepback 时事通讯应该能让您快速了解情况，但自今天早上以来已经有了一些新的进展。其中包括有传言称黄仁勋可能正在试图寻找重返首席执行官的道路，[...]
chineseContent: 围绕英伟达联合创始人兼前首席执行官黄仁勋的戏剧正在迅速演变。我们最新一期的 Stepback 时事通讯应该能让您快速了解情况，但自今天早上以来已经有了一些新的进展。其中包括黄仁勋可能试图寻找重返首席执行官之路的传言，以及 Megaspeed 的一份声明，声称爱丽丝黄自 2025 年 8 月以来就不再为该公司工作，这引发的问题多于答案。 * 包括埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 和 Epic Games 首席执行官蒂姆·斯威尼 (Tim Sweeney) 在内的一些知名人士已公开表示支持一封公开信，要求 Nvidia“让 Jensen 回归”。 * 要求黄仁勋复职的公开信已有超过15万个签名，但真实性难以验证。据《商业内幕》报道，签名包括“好莱坞演员蒂姆·克鲁斯”和“习近平”，这可能是中国国家主席习近平的拼写错误。 * 据《金融时报》报道，黄仁勋已与亲密盟友讨论了重新担任首席执行官的可能性，因为一些硅谷内部人士和员工试图向董事会施压。 * 并非所有人都认为黄仁勋应该被允许回到自己的座位上。据英国《金融时报》报道，一位盟友承认，“与下属发生外遇是一种可以解雇的罪行。” * 23andMe 创始人 Anne Wojcicki 告诉彭博社，“权力会腐败，人们开始认为自己是不可战胜的……我们都是串通一气，让这些人认为自己是神。而当人们认为自己是不可触碰的时候，就会做出愚蠢的事情。” * 沃西基与谷歌联合创始人谢尔盖·布林(Sergey Brin)公开离婚，原因是沃西基与一名员工有染。 * 据彭博社报道，硅谷的许多女性将黄仁勋视为另一个人
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
